PD-0332991 may inhibit CDK4/6 with high selectivity, but off-target kinase inhibition at 0.5 µM could contribute to histone mark changes; donor kinase inhibitors with different selectivity (vemurafenib, TG101348, trametinib) may show overlapping or distinct histone perturbation profiles.

The observed histone mark changes may reflect a general stress or transcriptional response rather than direct CDK4/6 inhibition; donors with high anchor similarity but unrelated mechanisms (e.g., vemurafenib) could indicate non-specific chromatin effects.

Model disagreement (ridge, phenotype, chemical) may arise from differences in feature scaling or donor weighting; the chemical model's stronger negative value suggests that structural or pharmacological similarity to CDK inhibitors drives the prediction, while phenotype model may rely on broader cellular responses.
